}; tap_node(){ attr=$1; value=$2; dump; coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml "$attr" "$value"); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $coords; sleep 1; }; master_state(){ xmllint --xpath 'string((//node[@checkable="true" and @enabled="true"])[1]/@checked)' /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml 2>/dev/null; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; sleep 2; tap_node content-desc Menu; tap_node text Settings; tap_node text 'Alerts & Collection'; dump; current=$(master_state); echo detection_at_start=$current; if [ "$current" != true ]; then master=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $master; sleep 1; fi; test_coords=''; for i in 1 2 3 4; do dump; if test_coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml text 'Test alert' 2>/dev/null); then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 1750 500 650 350; sleep 1; done; test -n "$test_coords"; echo test_alert_coords=$test_coords; echo '--- diagnostics-before-tap ---'; sed 's/></>\n</g' /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml | grep -E 'text="(POST_NOTIFICATIONS|Notifications enabled|Heads-up channel|Tray channel|Last alert result|Granted|Missing|Enabled|Blocked|POSTED|BLOCKED_BY_[A-Z_]+|FAILED|Alert )' | tail -n 40 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $test_coords; sleep 2; dump; echo '--- diagnostics-after-tap ---'; sed 's/></>\n</g' /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml | grep -E 'text="(POST_NOTIFICATIONS|Notifications enabled|Heads-up channel|Tray channel|Last alert result|Granted|Missing|Enabled|Blocked|POSTED|BLOCKED_BY_[A-Z_]+|FAILED|Alert )' | tail -n 60 || true; echo '--- notification-match ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -i -E 'BlueEye test alert|settings-test-alert|io.blueeye' | head -n 80 || true; echo '--- permission-match ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | grep -A2 -B2 'android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS' | head -n 20 || true; for i in 1 2 3 4; do dump; if python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-diag.xml text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable >/tmp/master-coords 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 650 500 1800 350; sleep 1; done; dump; final=$(master_state); echo detection_before_restore=$final; if [ "$final" = true ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $(cat /tmp/master-coords); sleep 1; fi; dump; restored=$(master_state); echo detection_restored=$restored; test "$restored" = false; echo PHASE3_ALERT_DISPATCH_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS
